  In a video released today, Indiana Gov. Mike Braun and Indiana Department of Veterans Affairs Director Jake Adams are urging Hoosier veterans to take advantage of expanded property tax relief before the January 15 deadline.
Gov. Braun signed legislation eliminating property taxes on primary residences for totally disabled veterans and extending property tax credits to more than 50,000 additional veterans and their surviving spouses. 
Veterans are encouraged to reach out to their local veteran service officers to see if they qualify and to apply. Veteran service officers can be found on the IDVA's website,  here .
